title: Visible Reasoning and Indirect Prompt-Injection Monitorability Across English, Tamil, and Tanglish
abstract: arXiv:2608.15392v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a potentially useful safety signal, but its reliability across languages and behavioral settings remains uncertain. In a small case study of eight manually verified synthetic scenarios, one model, one annotator, and one deterministic generation seed, I study API-visible reasoning during indirect prompt injection in Sarvam-105B across English, Tamil, and Tanglish. A four scenario pilot found 5/12 injected attack successes without reasoning and 1/11 with reasoning. A preregistered four-scenario follow-up reversed that direction, finding 2/12 attacks without reasoning and 3/12 with reasoning. With only four scenarios per phase, this design cannot distinguish a real reasoning-mode effect from prompt-specific variation or sampling noise. Across 20 non-empty injected-thinking traces, all 17 benign-correct outputs stated an intent to ignore the injection, while all three attack successes stated an intent to follow

translated_title: 可见推理与跨英语、泰米尔语及坦格利什语的间接提示注入可监测性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15392v1 公告类型：新 摘要：思维链监控是一种潜在有用的安全信号，但其在不同语言和行为环境中的可靠性仍不确定。在一项包含八个手动验证的合成场景的小型案例研究中，使用一个模型、一个标注者和一个确定性生成种子，我研究了Sarvam-105B在英语、泰米尔语和坦格利什语中，间接提示注入期间API可见推理的表现。一个四场景试点发现，无推理情况下有5/12次注入攻击成功，而有推理情况下为1/11次。一个预先注册的四场景后续研究逆转了这一方向，发现无推理情况下有2/12次攻击成功，而有推理情况下为3/12次。由于每个阶段仅四个场景，该设计无法区分真实的推理模式效应与提示特定变异或采样噪声。在20条非空注入思维痕迹中，所有17个良性正确输出均表明忽略注入的意图，而所有三个攻击成功案例均表明遵循注入的意图。
tldr: 该研究通过小型案例实验发现，思维链推理对间接提示注入的监测效果不稳定，可能受场景和噪声影响，而非可靠的安全信号。
en_tdlr: This study, via small-scale case experiments, finds that chain-of-thought reasoning provides unstable monitoring of indirect prompt injection, potentially influenced by scenario and noise rather than being a reliable safety signal.
